# Nexus Forge

> Open source workspace that combines data analytics, machine learning, AI document Q&A and cybersecurity log analysis. Built by Nikhil Chary Sriramoju, a final-year B.Tech Computer Science student in Telangana, India.

Nexus Forge runs as static pages with an optional FastAPI backend. Every analysis tool also works in the browser when the API is offline.

## Pages
- [Workspace](https://nexus-forge.vercel.app/workspace): CSV analytics, regression, clustering, classification, anomaly detection and document Q&A
- [Threat monitor](https://nexus-forge.vercel.app/monitor): log analysis for injection attempts and brute-force logins
- [Architecture](https://nexus-forge.vercel.app/architecture): technology stack and how the parts connect
- [Credentials](https://nexus-forge.vercel.app/about): education, internships and certifications of the builder
- [FAQ](https://nexus-forge.vercel.app/faq): common questions about hosting and configuration

## Source
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Nikhil-creat/nexus-forge): code, tests and deployment files
